title: Release the approved RepoPact 3.0 package boundary

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: RepoPact's version, conformance claim, README, roadmap, and accepted release decision identify 3.0.0 as the breaking release that replaces the documented vendored scripts interface with the installed `repopact` CLI.

A deterministic release builder exports a clean committed source tree, builds the sdist and wheel without inheriting stale checkout build products, and fails unless the wheel contains only the `repopact` import root, eight packaged schemas, six packaged templates, and no deprecated data-files entries.

The exact release wheel installs in an isolated Windows environment outside the checkout; generic flat imports are absent, importlib.resources resolves package seeds, and installed-CLI init/adopt repositories validate.

The project declares a reproducible development environment including build, twine, and pytest, and current README/ROADMAP guidance no longer presents completed WI-033/WI-036 as active or the pre-3.0 vendored command boundary as current.
The release tree passes governance validation, all conformance cases, the full unit suite in under two minutes locally, twine metadata checks, and the frozen-surface backstop.

Commit and annotated v3.0.0 tag are pushed to the public default branch; the exact validated artifacts are published to PyPI and a no-cache clean install verifies the public wheel hash and supported CLI behavior.

Package publication and adopter rollout remain distinct: public 3.0.0 publication is recorded without claiming ecosystem completion or CI restoration, and WI-037 continues to own downstream migration and stronger Moto parity proof.
